ticket.summary: Recurring low pressure at master shower only, both hot and cold; prior March visit diagnosed worn cartridge, customer now approving replacement.

quote_lines.description: Faucet/shower cartridge replacement — master shower valve

ticket.customer_message: That tracks — a worn pressure-balance cartridge in one shower valve is exactly what causes weak flow on both hot and cold while the rest of the house is fine. Cartridge replacement is $159 flat (labor + standard cartridge), about an hour on site, no after-hours charge. If the tech finds the valve body itself is shot, he'll stop and get your OK before doing anything extra. I've penciled you in for Tuesday Sept 1 at 10:30 AM — reply if you'd rather have Wednesday morning.
